has reply

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasReply
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasReply
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/notes

Relates an annotation or comment to a reply comment. Transitive: the full reply tree is reachable. Superproperty of hasDirectReply. Intentionally kept free of OWL cardinality so that deep thread trees remain DL-regular (no cardinality explosion).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Entity -> gmeow:Comment

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hasReply from gmeow:Entity to gmeow:Comment when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
